mapper.select: SELECT M.EMAIL, MD.NAME, M.NICKNAME, MD.BIRTH_DATE, MD.GENDER, MD.PHONE, MD.REGION, MD.JOB_STATUS, MD.INCOME_LEVEL, MD.PROFILE_IMG, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND BOARD_STATUS = 'Y') AS BOARD_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISH WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS WISH_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND REPLY_STATUS = 'Y') AS REPLY_COUNT FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
